detail.longDescription:
I've been working on this for a long while now.  It started as a simple script to generate a believable planet for my role playing game.  I'm a science and math nerd though, so I wanted to build it with science.  I then realized to do that I needed a star, so I built that.  Now I've written it to basically generate a segment of a galaxy with sectors, each sector has a density of stars (calculated based on what we observe in our own galaxy) and each star is generated as a system.

https://github.com/dwhagar/planetGen

DISCLOSURE:  While versions 1-4 did not use AI and I coded it entirely by hand, I have been using #AI in version 5.  I know this is controversial, but please if you have something negative to say just keep it to yourself. I would never have paid anyone to do this and I am never going to sell this at all.

#programming #python #scifi #science #sciencefiction
